text: 1、市场全天冲高回落，创业板指午后跌超2%。燃气股逆势走强，东方环宇4连板，洪通燃气涨停。消费股表现活跃，好当家、广百股份、惠发食品等涨停。算力芯片股盘中拉升，燧原科技涨超10%，寒武纪、沐曦股份涨超8%。下跌方面，AI漫剧概念下挫，上海电影跌停；机器人、物理AI概念走低，福莱新材等跌停。个股呈现普跌态势，沪深京三市超4600股飘绿，今日成交1.95万亿。截止收盘沪指跌0.67%，深成指跌1.68%，创业板指跌2.44%。 2、板块概念方面，军工、燃气、白酒、养殖等板块逆势走强，贵金属、游戏、AI漫剧、机器人等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共838只个股上涨，
text_en: 1. The market rose and then fell throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index down more than 2% in the afternoon. Gas stocks strengthened against the trend; Dongfang Huanyu hit four consecutive limit-ups and Hongtong Gas hit the limit-up. Consumer stocks were active, with Haodangjia, Guangbai Holdings, and Huifa Food hitting the limit-up. Computing power chip stocks pulled up during the session; Enflame Technology rose more than 10%, and Cambricon and MetaX rose more than 8%. On the decline side, the AI comic-drama concept fell, with Shanghai Film hitting the limit-down; robotics and physical AI concepts weakened, with Fulaixin Materials hitting the limit-down. Stocks showed a broad decline, with more than 4,600 stocks falling across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets; today's turnover was 1.95 trillion yuan. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.67%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.68%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.44%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, defense, gas, baijiu, and breeding sectors strengthened against the trend, while precious metals, gaming, AI comic-drama, and robotics sectors were among the biggest decliners. 3.
